selected.name: Hexaa
selected.reason: Highest-craft editorial system in the set (serif-italic-in-sans, live invoice-UI hero mock, volume-slider ROI calculator) that reads as authored, not templated.

selected.name: Enso Labs
selected.reason: Dark editorial art direction a studio would sign, with a live LangGraph terminal as proof-of-shipping and a 'no vanity metrics' proof-grid framing.

selected.name: GoGloby
selected.reason: Best risk-reversal in the batch ($3M liability + 120-day guarantee) plus recognizable client logos and a sharp production-without-risk niche thesis.

selected.name: Frontier Foundry
selected.reason: Highest-credibility firm (real gov logos, ex-FDIC-CIO founder) that teaches category-owning framing ('three-part sovereignty test') and bespoke technical diagram art.

selected.name: HelloAgentic
selected.reason: Master class in productized fixed-shape offers, contrarian thesis ('a demo is not a system'), and building trust via unit-economics transparency with zero client logos.

selected.name: Grace & Cronos
selected.reason: Interaction-led content: clickable Leverage Map, named methodology, and a productized 30-day assessment with a week-by-week deliverable timeline.

selected.name: InitializeAI
selected.reason: The definitive diagnostic-as-lead-magnet playbook: hero scorecard UI, free Gap Score, ROI calculator, and named downloadable toolkits per step.

selected.name: Beige Bananas
selected.reason: Strongest brand personality in the set (rotating hero verb, LaTeX 'equation' graphic) and anonymized-but-specific testimonials that keep credibility without named clients.

selected.name: Human Pilots AI
selected.reason: Best enablement/advisory positioning: verbatim board-anxiety pain cards, the ARC framework, and sticky reframes on a restrained Squarespace build.

selected.name: FirmAdapt
selected.reason: Most product-like top-of-funnel — a free type-your-domain 8-lens scan and a whole suite of free micro-tools driving the funnel, with a HUD/telemetry aesthetic.

selected.name: WhiteBox
selected.reason: Model for logo-led trust (DoD/Vodafone/Carrefour) and demoing real work via an embedded live forecasting data-viz, in a high-craft minimal dark style.

selected.name: Evren AI
selected.reason: Warm serif-on-peach palette that breaks the cold-navy AI-site default, plus an AEO-aware FAQ written for buyers and AI assistants.

selected.name: Elucidate AI
selected.reason: SLA-tied, dated, vertical-tagged case studies and a bespoke 3D data-mesh hero show how to make metrics read as real, not vanity.

selected.name: aiChemist
selected.reason: Closest peer to a small SMB shop: transparent fixed-price roadmap CTA, hero ROI calculator anchored to price, and a full trust-without-logos playbook.

selected.name: Cocoon AI
selected.reason: Excellent 'meet you where you are' diagnostic self-selector routing felt problems to named service tiers, plus honesty about when AI is the wrong call.

selected.name: Anveshi.ai
selected.reason: Sustained single-metaphor branding (Sherpa expedition), humanist counter-positioning, and per-vertical GEO hooks — plus a cautionary hero-contrast failure.

selected.name: GreenData Ventures
selected.reason: Teaches how a young firm borrows credibility: quantified industry proof-point carousel and an 'AI Entourage' partner network in place of client logos.

selected.name: Execucom AI
selected.reason: Sharp objection-handling FAQ (verbatim buyer fears) and motive-tuned audience-segment cards speaking to three buyers on one page.

selected.name: GenAI Protos
selected.reason: Concrete-offering patterns: industry-tagged Solution cards as mini case studies and named productized accelerators framed as buyable IP.

selected.name: Sense7ai
selected.reason: Regulated-vertical positioning with radical-honesty trust copy ('certs earned, not claimed') and response-time SLAs stated in the CTA.
